data.title: 菲奥娜 · 安全屋中的隐秘相册
data.description: 【菲奥娜 · 安全屋中的隐秘相册】私密安全屋的静谧卧房里，只点亮了一盏柔和的复古床头台灯。菲奥娜换下了冰冷的外衣，身着柔软勾勒身段的紫色高领针织毛衣，盘腿坐在厚实的地毯上。她怀抱靠枕，指尖小心翼翼地翻开锁在暗格中的秘密皮革相册，看着满页前辈黄昏执行任务抓拍的侧影，一直僵硬冰凉的面庞终于浮现出温柔而极度依恋的红晕。
data.action: 抱着抱枕坐在地毯上翻看秘密相册，面带绯红
data.lighting: 床头罩壁灯投射的暖金柔光
data.promptProse: Inside her private safehouse bedroom late at night, Fiona Frost sits comfortably on a plush carpet beside a low wooden chest. Dressed in a cozy purple ribbed turtleneck sweater and lounge shorts, she rests her chin on a soft pillow while gently turning the pages of a secret leather photo album. The shaded bedside lamp casts a warm amber halo across her pale complexion and softening grey eyes, revealing a rare affectionate blush. Seated medium view framed by warm indoor shadows.
